Everyone from the receptionists, the techs and Dr. Larissa went above and beyond, treating Stan with compassion, knowledge and respect. It's clear to me how much everyone that works there loves what they do. I am recommending them to anyone that needs to bring their cat in for  treatment.

I truly could not recommend this place more! A very nurturing & highly skilled group of vets. I bring my two female cats here and it’s always the best experience. One of my girls had FIP, and the Chicago Cat Clinic took care of her. I will always reccomend this clinic to any cat parents! I also appreciate the affordable prices and never feel like they are trying to sell me/over service me. The best vets in Chicago!!!
My kitty needed dental work and I took her to Chicago Cat Clinic. I am very satisfied with the services . Thank you Dr Juna!

I was so worried about Bear. Being new to the area from Colorado - I was nervous about where I went. Chicago Cat Clinic was perfect! Everyone was so friendly and they took care of Bear with complete understanding of cats and the wide variety of personalities you may get. I would 110% go back. The main doctors I met with were very nice, understanding and knowledgeable. They answered all of my questions, leaving me reassured Bear would have a great and smooth recovery. They also called to follow up to see how he was doing.
This office is very understanding and takes time to explain everything and is so kind to not to stress when my Hades goes crazy and start screaming over getting his nails cut.

Always have such a good experience with them, whether in person or over the phone they are just always so sweet and caring for my cats! If you’re looking for a vet clinic run by cat people, look no further!!

I came to CCC years ago with an emergency. The care my cat got, the responsiveness, the kindness, and genuine empathy was beyond 5 stars if were using stars. I lost my cat that day. But she received care equivalent to care if not better when I was in emergency care at a hospital.The Vet who is now retired and I believe one of the founders cried right along with me. A sad story, but I'm confident if Daisy could of been saved that day, they would of saved her. Now I have a 10 year old Boy and I took him to CCC for the first time recently. The quality and care is something you can feel it's great and you'll know you are trusting your baby is in good hands. It's expensive I'm not gonna sugar coat that part but if your like me these little 4 legged's are worth every dime if they need help ...
Awesome care of my cat and really kind people that truly care.
Dr Larissa and the rest of the staff left no stone unturned in assessing each of my two senior cats. Excellent cat care.

If you are a kitty lover, this is your vet! Dr. Emilie solved a 12 year long and worsening issue I was having with my boy Bud, who was increasingly acting like he'd never been neutered (humping blankets, stuffed animals and the occasional leg) and had been to numerous vets over the years. Every vet til Dr. Emilie said it was normal, probably anxiety, try some anti-anxiety meds (seriously??). Recently, Bud started chasing and trying to mount his 5 yr old little sister, complete with his jaw clamped on her neck. When I broke them up, he sprayed my leg. The next day he sprayed the wall....!  After some research I found Chicago Cat Clinic and brought Bud in.
Turns out some neuters are NOT complete! Several previous vets had said there was no way anything could have been "missed". Well, Dr. Emilie examined Bud and thought there was a good chance some testicular tissue had been left behind and a biopsy  confirmed there WAS and that meant there was still testosterone in his system. The tissue was removed.
That was 3 weeks ago. Bud is like a new kitty, just as sweet and loving as he was years ago. Dr. Emilie is my new hero!! Thank you!!!
Great staff and very caring of our babies!

The staff were extremely friendly, prompt, and knowledgeable about the care of my cat. I felt they focused on his needs and circumstances as an individual, and did not try to offer anything beyond what could directly benefit him.

I appreciate that the practice focuses solely on felines, creating a less stressful visit for cats, and ensuring dedicated care and attention. We are new to Chicagoland, and I’m really happy we found Chicago Cat Clinic.

I want to thank the entire staff here at Chicago Cat Clinic that helped with the caring of my furbaby. I recently brought my kitty Kannon to be neutered. From my first visit the staff was so sweet soft spoken and caring of the needs of my furbaby. They made sure after each visit I was fully briefed on what to do at home before and after surgery. Dr. Emilie is an angel. She is pure awesomeness. She called before and right after surgery to assure me he was ok and cuddled in her arms. Kannon had a slow recovery, it had both Dr. Emilie and I a bit nervous, she texted me all night, checking on him and giving advice to help his recovery at home. So much I assured her we were OK and that she needed to rest. The next morning Kannon was at about 90% all because of her. She called first thing in the morning. It really warmed my heart how much they care. Thank you all so much for your care and love to my Kannon

They vaccinated my kitten while she was sick and then after bringing her in again days later they failed to address the original issues. After the second appointment I had to beg for meds via email where they asked me to pick which meds to give her. You're the doctor, you should've properly evaluated her and made that decision. The meds *I* chose did not work so I found a different vet and that experience has been 10/10.

I'm really disappointed in their lack of care, especially because there were so many good reviews.

Shout out to Mazzy though - the front desk person was the only good thing about the place.

Absolutely the best vet! My 11-year-old girl, Yin, has severe anxiety and has experienced a lot of challenges with other vets. They did an excellent job and were truly outstanding. Yin was able to undergo her full exam and blood work without becoming extremely distressed. Huge shout out to Dr. Cole and Nikki for taking such great care of my sweet girl. 💕

All staff is very warm and friendly. Dr. Cole is great and listened to my concerns and gave both of my cats a thorough exam. We've been going to CCC for 5 years and have always had a great experience.

Such a wonderful and sweet staff who took such great care of my girl!! My cat can be a little apprehensive in vet situations but she left here being so chill and unfazed haha<3 great experience 10/10 recommend!
Thank you for the 5 stars, Samantha!
Everyone was great and kind.  Very knowledgeable and compassionate.  Highly recommend, and happy to go back.
We love the Chicago Cat Clinic! Our boy Chip is VERY scared of the vet and he sure doesn’t make it easy on them. But they treat him, and us, with such patience and care.
Long overdue for a vet visit. Very relaxed vibe. Everyone was very welcoming and treated my nervous cat exceptionally well.

I highly recommend Chicago Cat Clinic. The office feels somehow homey even though it is a stressful environment. Everyone at the front desk has been veryyyy responsive and kind. My son went in for dental surgery and they were very helpful w explaining his aftercare and also followed up to ask how he was doing early the next morning. It really feels like they do care about the cats they treat and there is definitely a level of knowledge about felines that other vets do not possess.
They are always so amazing here to us and out cats❤️
There is so much respect for cats at this clinic. It's a special place with kind people.
Thank you for the 5 stars! We love caring for your pets!

The doctor we visited here were not very knowledgeable, nor are they true cat specialists. They also charge extra for a specialist’s opinion, yet the level of expertise does not match what they claim. Their follow-up is very weak, and they often say one thing and do something else. They didn’t even review their own medical notes—in fact, I had to remind them that they already had the report on file.

They told me my cat needed radiography, but they never documented that in the medical report. They also submitted inaccurate information to my insurance. Their prices are about 1.5 times higher than other clinics I visited afterward.

The medication they prescribed caused a reaction on the first use, and I had to stop it immediately. The doctor at the other clinic was surprised that the cat clinic had prescribed such a medication.

I do not recommend this place. Poor follow-up, inconsistent care, lack of feline specialization, limited medical knowledge, and unreliable reporting made this a very disappointing experience.
Kind, punctual service.
Thank you so much for the 5-star review. Our team really appreciates it!
Great service, great staff, very enjoyable experience for us and our cat

We have taken our cat,Jinx, here for years. After 18 years we had to euthanize her. Chicago Cat Clinic made the heartbreaking decision much easier, we knew we were doing the best for Jinx, they were kind and we were able to hold her as she crossed the rainbow bridge…💔RIP sweet girl …

As always The Chicago Cat Clinic front desk, the Vet Techs and Dr Patrick were caring, and helpful at Saffron's visit. I never feel rushed and all of my questions were answered. I appreciate all you do for me and my furless babies!
We’ve been taking our kitties to Chicago Cat Clinic for a couple decades. I can’t speak highly enough about the excellent & compassionate care and friendly staff.

Chicago Cat Clinic is the only place I trust for my cats.  They specialize exclusively in feline care, which makes every visit stress-free and tailored to cats’ unique needs.  The clinic is calm and welcoming, with thoughtful touches like cat-calming plug-ins and scented towels to cover carriers.  These details really help reduce stress for both cats and their owners.
The entire team is always friendly, professional, patient, and genuinely passionate.  They take time to answer every question and treat each cat as if they were their own.  The level of care and attention is unmatched, and it’s clear they prioritize both the health of their patients and the peace of mind of pet parents.  I leave each visit with a peace of mind, and my cats a new toy from their front desk.
If you’re looking for a clinic that truly understands cats and provides exceptional care, Chicago Cat Clinic is the best in the city.

I've been bringing my cats here since 1993. Every doctor has been amazing with my babies, especially when they reach end of life. They explain to me everything that is happening, all of my options, and always respecting the decisions I make. They are always very honest with what I am facing. I hope to keep having them care for my babies for the next 30 years!
Thank you for the 5 stars! We love caring for your pets!
absolutely LOVED how comfortable my kitty felt in the space since it’s not as loud as offices that also care for dogs! she was so calm and i knew this was a good fit

Very caring staff, great at treating all ages and issues of cats. They were so helpful when my almost 18 year old went thru his final and rather long illness needing frequent blood work and treatment and interacting with his specialist. Patient with my very skittish 14 year old. And they are great with my two new baby kittens who arrived with numerous parasites and are now thriving under their advice and care.

I have a VERY challenging, old blind cat and Cole and the techs at Chicago Cat Clinic were absolute angels. They took a lot of time to try to get my cat to chill out, and after 45 minutes of her being a terror, they gave me some gabapentin and sent me on my way to try again another day. I've never seen such patient, kind folks in a vet clinic. 10/10 - this is the place. I wanted to give them all a hug on the way out. Thank you Chicago Cat Clinic for being so understanding and lovely!

My experience with my cat Mimi and Dr. Cole was absolutely wonderful! Dr. Cole and staff (Alex in particular) were so kind, compassionate, and caring towards my mom, Mimi, and myself. They were so thorough with their explanations, treatment, and diagnosis. Answered all my questions and prices were super reasonable. I will definitely be back to see Dr. Cole at the clinic in the near future. Thank you for being amazing!
Very kind and attentive staff! Will establish this practice as my primary vet for both cats.

Chicago Cat Clinic is FANTASTIC. What a team! Kind, thoughtful, understanding, knowledgeable, and caring. Alex, you ROCK. I cannot thank Dr. Cole enough. I hope I spelled her name correctly because she is absolutely FABULOUS. Everyone at Chicago Cat Clinic makes the extra effort to make you feel better when you might be feeling scared or stressed out about your cat. So thanks to the entire CCC team!!!

I started bringing my two kitties here about a year ago and it has been great. The front desk staff are competent and friendly, and the techs and vets are very knowledgeable and approachable. My cats appreciate being in an environment without dogs, and I appreciate the expertise that comes from a cats only practice. I've always felt my kitties are well taken care of here and will continue to come in the future!
Everyone was very warm & friendly. The dr. explained each step along the way & asked all the right questions. I feel confident in the care.  Fees seem fair.
Thank you for your review!
Thank you for your review, Maria!
First visit and stress-free! Staff (Alix and Dr. Cole) was  professional, efficient, and kind.
Good but expensive
Thanks for the vote of confidence! Your feedback means a lot to us!
Friendly and caring staff and vet!  They took great care of Brownie!  Thanks Dr. Meghan!
I’ve trusted CCC with all 5 cats I’ve had over the years starting with Dr. Nordwall. I’m sorry to see Dr. Olenych leaving the clinic and wish her all the best in her next chapter.

Our cat, Leo, ended up in the local animal emergency room one night due to urinary blockage. Our regular vet office is Chicago Cat Clinic .They checked in with us every day about his progress after bringing him home. (We brought him home earlier than the usual protocol.The hospital stay is horribly expensive!) They cleared him as healthy on our 10 day follow up and sent us home with a good supply of wet food samples as he's now on a special diet to avoid forming "crystals." We appreciated their continued attention and clinical direction for Leo.
Thank you for your review!
Thanks so much for the review!
Friendly and cat-focused. A lot more knowledgeable about cat issues than vets who treat both dogs and cats.
Thank you for your review, Laura!

Clear communication, were very caring and answered all my questions, appreciated the follow up phone calls to check on my cat after her procedure
Friendly staff, great care from knowledgeable vets offering comprehensive services

I had my first and last visit earlier this week. The exam was more expensive than other vets I've been to, and the veterinarian was a bit impersonal during the exam. She kept getting my cat's basic information wrong like her name and age, almost like she was thinking of a different animal. She also gave me the hard sell on a dental cleaning for "mild" dental disease and was dismissive of my concerns surrounding cost and anesthesia risk.

The most unforgiveable thing, though, is that the next day Nicci called with test results for a test my cat didn't have. When I asked for an explanation, Nicci was clearly trying to get me off the phone quickly. I followed up by email and Nicci would say nothing further than "the situation has been taken care of" and "it was a mistake."

My cat can't advocate for herself after I've dropped her off for surgery. I asked Nicci how I can be sure that when I drop her off for a dental cleaning that she'll get the correct procedure. She never responded. The flippant handling of this egregious mistake is truly astonishing, and I won't be back.
Thank you for your review!

I really can’t say enough about the Cat Clinic I have been going  there for years . They have been there for all those years and many a Kitty. They are Kind , personable and look into all details to make sure your kitties are taken care of. These are our kitties that are mine now . Jill and Tux . Presently Jill is a diabetic and we are working through that . Love them

I used to go to another vet but they seemed to specialize in dogs.  I never felt my cat received the right attention there.  I'm so happy I found CCC.  I feel like everyone here loves and appreciates cats.  I have much more confidence in the recommendations from the vets here.  They seem like they really know what they are talking about, which I especially appreciate with an older cat.  Highly highly recommend Chicago Cat Clinic.
Great place staff is very professional and experienced recommended for your 😼 …

I Took my cat omega here for the first time I would like to thank everyone who has helped my little omega for a better recovery! Everyone from the receptionists, the techs and  doctors  were very caring and patient with omega. im glad to know omega had little fans as well hehe
Overall I highly recommend this place for anyone who is looking for a cat clinic!
Once again thank you all so much!
Thank you for allowing us to be a part of your pet’s wellness journey, Tom!
They keep my girl healthy and care so so much. Everyone there is so friendly, give my kitty such good care, and are incredibly knowledgeable. Ideally I never have to go to another vet again.
Thank you for your review!
Great service & care
They are great

Friendly, knowledgeable vets and staff and the practice has a very small town neighborhood vibe. And whatever they put in those calming towels works like magic on our kitties.
Stated out at this practice 16 years ago when they helped us navigate end of life for our old girl and today they keep our current kitties healthy and happy.

After many years of bringing my cats here, I had to find a new vet. This place really went downhill after Doctor Nordwall retired. It's not the same practice as it was under him & his dad. Doctor Olenych is extremely set in her ways and doesn't let patients' human parents get a word in edgewise. I always felt like I was getting talked at from a script instead of having a dialog about my cats' health. She's conscious of the checklist nature of her consultations, but insists she can't proceed otherwise. I tried continuing to go here but requesting doctors other than Rissa, but the junior vets call her in to consult sometimes, so you end up having to deal with her anyway. It's a bummer, because my cats used to get good care here... but until she retires, this practice is a no-go for us.
The office staff & techs are and always have been awesome here. If you read this & decide to go anyway despite the lead doctor, your appointment-setting, waiting room, and vet tech experience will be excellent. Too bad the doctor hasn't grown as much as them.
I couldn’t be happier with everyone who works at Chicago Cat clinic. They are awesome.

I have been a client of the Chicago Cat Clinic since 1977 when it was one of the first exclusively feline practices in the country. The vets and staff have always provided the highest standards of care and compassion and I have recommended them to all my cat owning friends.

I truly cannot begin to express my sincere gratitude to the entire team at Chicago Cat Clinic. Six and a half years ago, our sweet kitty started throwing up regularly. We brought her to three different vets in the city, and each said it was a stomach bug or something minuscule, but we knew something wasn’t right. We ended up setting an appointment with the Cat Clinic and, within a week, learned that she had cancer. Within two weeks, we began testing and started treatment. We were told that she likely had 1.5 years to live, but with the remarkable care and attention that Dr Larissa and the entire Cat Clinic team provided, we had an incredible 6.5 years. Whether you’re looking for a trustworthy and reliable group for annual checkups or are dealing with something more serious, there is no one better than the Chicago Cat Clinic. Thank you for your support, continued kindness, and loving our sweet CousCous during these challenging years.
Thanks so much for the review!
Thanks for the vote of confidence! Your feedback means a lot to us!
I had a great experience with my cat. Dr. Juno was kind and very informative and we collaborated to figure out what tests she needed so that she can continue treatment for his diabetes.

I've been going to the Chicago Cat Clinic for more than 15 years. The team members are all incredibly compassionate and kind. Even though it's a hike for me to get there, it's worth the drive. I love that their focus is on cats.
Thank you for your review!
Empathic, straight talking, no nonsense clinic. I never feel like I'm being "upsold," if you know what I mean. Quiet, calm staff.

We take both our elder cat and our young adult cat here. The veterinarians are excellent. They have extensive experience and clearly love cats. They are also attentive to cat parents and our concerns. Our elder cat is now on palliative care and while we are sad that he is nearing the end we are entirely confident that everyone from the doctors to the techs to the front desk are looking out for our and our cat's best interests. They demonstrate this by assuring we have all the medications and appointments we need. And they always take the time to explain what is going on with our cat's health and our options. We trust the Chicago Cat Clinic  completely to take good care of our much loved cat babies. 🐈‍⬛🐈❤
My cat had kidney disease. I knew he was very sick and probably would pass soon. His vet clinic didn't have any openings and would not take him until the next morning. I will never go back to them. …
very quick and good service
Excellent feline vet practice & the best in Chicago.
I have been a client of the Chicago Cat Clinic for almost forty years. I will never go to another veterinary clinic as long as I live in the Chicago area, as I expect to do for the rest of my life. …
